title: Slow Cooker Vego Chilli Non Carne
subtitle: with Smoked Cheddar and Warm Tortillas
description: We’re bringing you special recipes to make in your slow cooker! The ultimate in delicious, comforting goodness, they’re so darned simple – just follow the easy steps and watch your cooker do all the work. You can also cook this recipe in the oven using a casserole dish. If using a slow cooker, the cook time is about 8 hrs; if using a casserole dish, it's about 2 hrs.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat your slow cooker to low or preheat the oven to 150C. Quarter the capsicums. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the corn and beans.

Slow cooker method: If using the slow cooker, combine the capsicum, garlic, corn, beans, tomatoes, Tex-Mex seasoning, 1 tbs tomato paste, 1 tbs barbecue sauce, ½ tsp sugar and 80ml (⅓ cup) water in the slow cooker bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.

Casserole method: If using the casserole dish, combine the capsicum, garlic, corn, beans, tomatoes, Tex-Mex seasoning, 1 tbs tomato paste, 1 tbs barbecue sauce, ½ tsp sugar and 80ml (⅓ cup) water in a medium flameproof casserole dish. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and bring to the boil on the stovetop. Transfer the dish to the oven and bake, covered, for 2 hours.
Warm tortillas: Close to serving, coarsely grate the cheese. Put the tortillas on a plate, slightly overlapping, and microwave in 10-sec bursts until warmed through (see Kitchen 101).
Serve up: Taste the chilli non carne, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the chilli among bowls and scatter over the cheese. Serve with the tortillas and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Don't have a microwave? Warm the tortillas, wrapped in foil, in a 220C oven for 8 mins or until warmed through.
